node --import ./node_modules/tsx/dist/loader.mjs --input-type=module -e 'import {globalRegistry} from "./providers/registry.ts"; import {handleMultiAgentChatRequest} from "./handlers/multiAgentChat.ts"; let calls=[]; const p={id:"repro",name:"repro",type:"anthropic",supportsImages:()=>false,async *executeChat(r){calls.push(r); if(calls.length===1) yield {type:"tool_use",toolName:"delegate_task",toolInput:{agent_id:"worker",instructions:"Do work"},toolUseId:"tool-1"}; else yield {type:"text",content:"worker result"}; yield {type:"done"}}}; globalRegistry.registerProvider(p); for(const id of ["orchestrator","worker"]) globalRegistry.registerAgent({id,name:id,description:id,provider:"repro"}); const response=await handleMultiAgentChatRequest({req:{json:async()=>({message:"coordinate",requestId:"repro"})},var:{config:{debugMode:false}}},new Map()); console.log(await response.text()); console.log("Provider calls:",calls.length); if(calls.length<3) process.exitCode=1;'
